title: Augmented simplicial object of a counital coassociative endofunctor
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an ordinary category, $T:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ an endofunctor, and $e:T\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $c:T\to T^2$ natural transformations satisfying $(eT)\circ c=1_T=(Te)\circ c$ and $(cT)\circ c=(Tc)\circ c$. For $n\geq0$ set $B_n=T^{n+1}$, with $T^0=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$. The natural transformations $d_i=T^i e T^{n-i}:B_n\to B_{n-1}$ for $n\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq n$, and $s_i=T^i c T^{n-i}:B_n\to B_{n+1}$ for $0\leq i\leq n$, make $B_\bullet$ a simplicial object [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] in the category of endofunctors of $\mathcal C$. The map $e:B_0\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ extends to an augmentation $B_\bullet\to\operatorname{const}(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C})$. In particular evaluation at $x\in\mathcal C$ gives an augmented simplicial object, naturally in $x$.
